Marta (PM): Heads-up — ACME just asked if we can include their customer-specific ML evals in the v1 pilot. They want drift detection + per-tenant eval dashboards by launch.
Raj (Eng): that's a pretty big ask. Per-tenant evals will add storage + compute for nightly jobs. timeline impact?
Ivy (Product): ACME is a strategic pilot, but we already committed to v1 scope. We should quantify cost vs benefit. Can we ship a lightweight MVP: aggregate evals now, tenant detail later?
Jules (Design): for dashboards we can show a "tenant picker" placeholder that links to a separate beta report. Low design lift.
Marta (PM): Proposal: move full per-tenant evals to v1.1, ship a minimal on-launch signal: nightly aggregate + alerting for ACME only. That keeps launch date but gives them monitoring. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Raj (Eng): technical note — aggregate nightly evals + alerts is doable within current infra if we limit retention to 30 days. Full per-tenant history needs schema changes and ~2x storage estimate.
Ivy (Product): ok set constraints: (1) ACME gets per-tenant alerting + one-click request for deeper reports, (2) full historical per-tenant UI is v1.1, (3) no extra SLA promises for v1.
Marta (PM): can we get an estimate for the extra dev work and ops cost? Raj, can you drop numbers by EOD?
Raj (Eng): will do. Quick sketch: dev ~3 wks (1 eng + 0.5 infra), infra cost +$1.2k/mo for storage, runbook for nightly jobs + alerting + on-call touchpoints.
Jules (Design): I'll draft the lightweight dashboard state and the placeholder flow in Figma; will aim for a first pass by tomorrow.
Marta (PM): decision for roadmap doc: mark per-tenant historical evals as "v1.1 dependent — gating on infra budget approval" and add the minimal ACME pilot scope under v1. Action: Raj to add cost estimate, Jules to attach mockups, Ivy to update pilot contract.
Ivy (Product): tagging @deploy-bot — flag any infra quota impacts once Raj posts numbers.
deploy-bot: Note — current nightly job window 02:00-04:00 UTC; adding tenant-level jobs could push into adjacent maintenance windows. Please coordinate with eng-infra.
Raj (Eng): noted. If infra needs a quota bump we should file a request today to avoid schedule slip.
Marta (PM): OK — if estimates indicate >2 week slip we reconvene and consider pushing more cut items. Otherwise we proceed with the minimal approach.
Ivy (Product): One more thing — include a metric in launch criteria: "pilot has tenant-level alerting active for ACME and no false-positive rate > 5% over 72h". If unmet, trigger canary rollback.
Raj (Eng): agreed. I'll add instrumentation hooks in the nightly job and expose metrics to Console team.
Marta (PM): thanks everyone. I'll update the launch checklist and post the delta to the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
